_comment: Races to hold out of a launch: each entry is {pattern, reason}; pattern is a regex on the raceKey. Held entries stay in the manifest as status 'unresolved' (no payload, no cost); the dry run lists them and apply skips them. Example for the four states most likely to redraw their House map for 2028: {"pattern": "^2028-house-(GA|MD|MO|MS)-", "reason": "map likely to change for 2028 (see inventories/house-2028-states.json)"}.

holds.reason: Tod, 2026-11-06: no granular races past 2028 yet, only major markets. Every state-level race after 2028 (Senate, governor, state presidential and state popular vote) is held; the 2032 and 2036 national presidential markets stay.
